scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix front-end ci && npm --prefix back-end ci
scripts.check: npm run check:frontend && npm run check:backend && npm run test:backend
scripts.docker:clean: docker buildx history rm --all && docker buildx prune -af
scripts.api:generate: npm --prefix back-end run openapi:generate && npm --prefix front-end run api:generate
scripts.api:check: npm --prefix back-end run openapi:check && npm --prefix front-end run api:check
